messages:
deploy-bot: deploy launched: rollout-id=launch-843 model=v2.3-canary region=eu-west1 traffic=15%

maria: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs and p95 latency for eu-west1 on the new canary. +10% error rate vs baseline. linking grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/shot/launch-843

ashwin: confirmed. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 210ms, 5xx rate 0.9% -> 1.8% over the last 3m. sample logs show KV cache misses and occasional OOM on worker-4: 
```
OOM: worker-4 gpu0: mem alloc fail at seq len 512
2026-03-20T10:12:02Z rev = v2.3-canary
```

leo: thanks. rolling attenuation plan: reduce canary traffic to 5% and enable fallback to v2.2 for new sessions. can someone run the traffic-sweep? @sre_oncall?

sre_oncall: running attenuation now. executing: ```/deploy attenuate --id launch-843 --to 5% --mode gradual --duration 2m``` monitoring autoscaler and GPU memory. also bumping ephemeral pool by +1 for eu-west1 to drain pending requests.

maria: noted. can we pin the route for eu-west1 to v2.2-stable for 100% of new sess if retries > 2? want graceful degradation not hard rollback.

ashwin: we should also capture a replay log subset for the failing requests, saving prompt/context for eval. kicking off: ```/infra capture-replay --launch launch-843 --sample 200```

samir: product and infra: quick ask — do we want to abort the release entirely (full rollback) or attenuate and re-evaluate in 30m? need a decision for the oncall runbook.

product: prioritization: audience is internal beta customers in EU; prefer to stop and pin to avoid further customer impact. please escalate to full rollback if attenuation doesn’t hit error targets in 10m.

sre_oncall: attenuation complete, canary at 5%. 5xx down to 1.0% and p95 trending back to 140ms. continuing watch.

leo: request explicit go/no-go for continuing to 50% at the 30m mark. my vote: no-go until we confirm KV cache change from runtime team.

maria: no-go from eng-release side. want to validate OOM mitigation and replay results.

ashwin: replay captured. starting dry-run with patched cache policy on a shadow worker. will report in 12m.

deploy-bot: update: rollout-id=launch-843 traffic=5% status=attenuated pinned-route=none

samir: final call: if error rate <1.1% and p95 < 160ms at T+20m, we can re-open to 25% as a cautious step. otherwise perform rollback and pin. everyone ack?

maria: ack (no). still seeing anomalies in corner cases.

leo: ack (no-go).

ashwin: ack. starting rollback path now per request: ```/deploy rollback --id launch-843 --to-version v2.2-stable --force false```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: launch-843 -> v2.2-stable routing change in progress. expected cutover ~45s.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: launch-843 rolled back, region=eu-west1 now serving v2.2-stable 100%. route pinned to v2.2-stable until 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z or manual unpin.

maria: thanks all. filing a post-deploy ticket with logs + action items: reduce memory footprint, patch KV cache, add canary memory guardrails. ticket -> ENG-4121

product: updating release notes and notifying affected beta customers. good triage. :thumbsup:
